Disclaimer: Other ordinances which have been passed are to be included in the Code and will be codified on a periodic basis. As a consequence, the current version of this Code should not be relied upon as the definitive authority on all local legislation. Please contact the Executive Office of the Board at (213) 974-1426 to ascertain if other ordinances of interest to you have been adopted since the last update of this version.
WebIntro: The Los Angeles County Code is a compilation of County ordinances of a general nature which have been codified, chaptered and indexed.
